howtos.title: Turn on Claude Code Code Mode
howtos.what: Opt in to an experimental mode where Claude writes scripts that chain your tools and answers during long commands.
copy: Set CLAUDE_CODE_EXPERIMENTAL_CODE_MODE=1 in your environment before starting Claude Code.
Let Claude write scripts that chain your tools; it can answer you while long commands still run.
howtos.whenToUse: When tasks need many tool calls in sequence or long-running commands you want to keep talking through.
